result:
Round 370 is accepted, and round 371 is written and ready for A. The decision is **CONTINUE**.

**Round 370 (PERF-11a: chat library loads only when chat starts, no fade-in on Studio pages)**
- C passed it: 16 rows passed, 0 bugs, and the browser checks ran at both viewports. The chat-connection row stays blocked because there is no backend in the cloud; that is open evidence, not a defect.
- Gate 370 published it as `f530e2d`, which is the new baseline.
- The reviewers' notes were all Low. I moved them to `deferred_low_polish`. One of them, a test that may break on a router version bump, is flagged to be fixed the next time a round owns that test file.
- The old task is saved as `tasks/round-370.md`; the backlog is now v336, and `feature-status.md` is updated.

**PERF-11c split into three stages.**
- **11c-i (round 371):** the track-group header.
- **11c-ii:** moving the status line's text out of the shared Studio state. 28 test files read it from there today, so that stage needs a test-migration grant.
- **11c-iii:** the remaining components that read the whole shared state, plus the slow first frame.

**Round 371: what A changes.** A applies a sketch I prepared and checked. The group header no longer reads the whole shared Studio state. StudioWorkspace passes it its actions and solo state, and the compiler now forces the header's prop comparison to list every prop. The same round fixes one error message that named the wrong hook.

**Evidence from my sketch run:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| New test rows on HEAD | GH1, GH2, GH5 and L8d fail on HEAD, as intended |
| Mutants | all 8 turn their predicted rows red |
| Full suite on the sketch | 252 files, 3,703 tests pass |
| Typecheck, Biome, lint | all clean |
| Both perf specs, each run alone | pass, and their deterministic rows are unchanged; the demo has no track group, so the jsdom render rows are the real asserts |
| Browser baseline at HEAD (both viewports) | muting a lane outside a folded group re-renders the header once; the target is zero |
| `tech-lead` review | approved v1 with one Medium (a hand-written comparison could miss a new prop), which v2 fixes; approved v2 with nothing new at Medium or above; the reviewed sketch is the dispatched one |

**C checks:** source scope, claims, the five files equal the sketch, unit tests, mutants on A's tree, both perf specs alone, and group behaviour in the browser against my HEAD baseline. The group render count in the browser is record-only, because I didn't run a second dev server for the sketch. Also the auth guard, the Studio smoke test and the implementation doc.

**Consults:** `tech-lead` (two reviews) and `performance-optimizer`. The latter would keep the sketch as is, confirmed that the 11c-ii premise still holds, and pointed out that the marker row reads the status line too, so 11c-ii must handle it. The advisor was available and I used it twice.

**What comes next:** REGRESSION at the first planning on or after 2026-11-08, then 11c-ii, then 11c-iii, then PERF-11b if root or Saba answers. At 11c-ii I'll ask root for a bounded `frontend-architect` checkpoint, because it adds a new store to the shared state; the request won't hold that stage up.

Nothing in `store/` changed (still `f530e2d`, clean). All planning files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`; the evidence is in `b-round-370/`.
